title: Instructional Equipment

onscreen_lines.desc: Ultrasound systems for the Diagnostic Medical Sonography Program of Study. The equipment will be used in an instructional environment to provide students with hands-on experience in diagnostic ultrasound imaging, including image acquisition, patient positioning, scanning techniques, anatomy identification, image optimization, measurements, and other sonography-related skills. The proposed systems should provide functionality and performance appropriate for an educational setting while supporting the program's current and anticipated instructional needs. The selected vendor(s) shall provide all equipment, components, accessories, software, licenses, installation, configuration, training, documentation, warranty, technical support, and other services necessary to provide a complete and fully operational solution, as applicable to the proposed equipment.
onscreen_lines.note: See Exhibit A for full specifications. Please include training, delivery, software and warranty price when bidding on equipment.

onscreen_lines.desc: Ultrasound systems for the Adult Cardiac Sonography Program of Study The equipment will be used in an instructional environment to provide students with hands-on experience in adult cardiac ultrasound and echocardiography, including patient positioning, cardiac imaging, image acquisition and optimization, Doppler techniques, cardiac measurements and calculations, anatomical identification, and evaluation of cardiac structures and function. The proposed systems should provide current technology, high-quality imaging capabilities, appropriate cardiac-specific functionality, ease of use, durability, and performance suitable for an educational environment. Equipment should support faculty instruction and student development of the technical skills necessary for successful transition to clinical practice. The selected vendor(s) shall provide all equipment, transducers, accessories, software, licenses, installation, configuration, training, documentation, warranty, technical support, and other services necessary to provide a complete and fully operational solution, as applicable to the proposed equipment.
onscreen_lines.note: See Exhibit B for full specifications. Please include training, delivery, software and warranty price when bidding on equipment.

onscreen_lines.desc: Echocardiography upgrade simulator for the Adult Cardiac Sonography Program of Study The proposed system should support faculty instruction, student practice, skills development, and competency assessment while providing realistic simulation experiences related to adult cardiac sonography. The equipment should be suitable for repeated instructional use and meet the specifications and requirements outlined in this RFP (Exhibit C). Vendors should provide complete information regarding the proposed simulator, including all required hardware, software, transducers, accessories, training, installation, warranty, technical support, maintenance, and any additional features or services included with the proposed system.
onscreen_lines.note: See Exhibit C for full specifications. Please include training, delivery, software and warranty price when bidding on equipment.

onscreen_lines.desc: Multi-therapy Infusion Pump Kit for EMS Program of Study The requested infusion pump kits should provide students with practical experience in the operation and use of infusion pump technology in simulated patient-care environments. The equipment should support instruction in medication and fluid administration, infusion management, pump programming, troubleshooting, and other applicable EMS procedures. The proposed equipment should be appropriate for an academic EMS training environment and meet the specifications and requirements outlined in this RFP (Exhibit D). Vendors are encouraged to provide complete information regarding the equipment, included components and accessories, software or related technology, training, warranty, technical support, and any additional features or services included with the proposed system.
onscreen_lines.note: See Exhibit D for full specifications. Please include training, delivery, software and warranty price when bidding on equipment.

onscreen_lines.desc: Video Laryngoscope System The requested system should provide students with the opportunity to develop proficiency in video-assisted airway visualization, laryngoscopy, intubation techniques, and proper use and care of the equipment. The system should be suitable for repeated instructional use and support faculty demonstration, student practice, and competency assessment. The proposed Video Laryngoscope System should meet the specifications and requirements outlined in this RFP (Exhibit E). Vendors should provide complete information regarding the system, including the video display, laryngoscope components, blades or other required accessories, charging and storage equipment, warranty, training, technical support, and any other included features or services.
onscreen_lines.note: See Exhibit E for full specifications. Please include training, delivery, software and warranty price when bidding on equipment.

onscreen_lines.desc: Advanced Airway Solution Complete Kit for Advanced Airway Management and CPR Practice The requested kit should provide students with realistic opportunities to develop and demonstrate proficiency in advanced airway techniques, ventilation, CPR, and related emergency patient-care procedures. The equipment should support faculty instruction, student practice, skills assessment, and competency development consistent with EMS education and training requirements. The proposed Advanced Airway Solution Complete Kit should meet the specifications and requirements outlined in this RFP (Exhibit F) and be suitable for repeated use in an academic EMS training environment. Vendors should provide complete information regarding all equipment and accessories included in the kit, applicable training or instructional resources, warranty, technical support, replacement components, and any additional features or services included with the proposed system.
onscreen_lines.note: See Exhibit F for full specifications. Please include training, delivery, software and warranty price when bidding on equipment.

onscreen_lines.desc: Transcranial Doppler (TCD) non-imaging unit for the Vascular Sonography Program of Study The requested TCD system should provide students with practical experience in performing non-imaging transcranial Doppler examinations, including the identification and evaluation of intracranial blood flow velocities and waveforms. The system should support faculty instruction, student practice, competency development, and clinical skills preparation within an academic healthcare education environment. The proposed TCD Non-Imaging Unit should meet the specifications and requirements outlined in this RFP (Exhibit G) and be suitable for instructional and laboratory use. Vendors should provide complete information regarding the proposed system, including transducers/probes, software, accessories, training resources, warranty, technical support, and any additional features or services included with the equipment.
onscreen_lines.note: See Exhibit G for full specifications. Please include training, delivery, software and warranty price when bidding on equipment.

onscreen_lines.desc: CNC Machines Tending Robots The requested robotic systems should provide opportunities for students to develop practical skills in robot programming, operation, integration, and safe interaction with CNC equipment. The equipment should support instructional demonstrations, hands-on laboratory activities, skills development, and exposure to current industrial automation technologies and practices. The proposed CNC Machine Tending Robots should meet the specifications and requirements outlined in this RFP (Exhibit H) and be suitable for use in an academic advanced manufacturing environment. Vendors should provide complete information regarding the proposed robotic system, including robot specifications, controls, grippers and tooling, safety features, CNC integration capabilities, software, training, installation, warranty, technical support, and any additional equipment or services included with the proposed system.
onscreen_lines.note: See Exhibit H for full specifications. Please include training, delivery, software and warranty price when bidding on equipment.

onscreen_lines.desc: Newborn Neonatal Simulation Equipment The requested simulation equipment should provide opportunities for students to develop and practice essential neonatal care skills, including newborn assessment, airway and respiratory management, vital sign monitoring, resuscitation, and recognition and response to common neonatal conditions and emergencies. The equipment should support faculty instruction, student practice, competency assessment, and clinical decision-making. The proposed Newborn Neonatal Simulation Equipment should meet the specifications and requirements outlined in this RFP (Exhibit I) and be suitable for repeated use in an academic healthcare simulation environment. Vendors should provide complete information regarding the proposed equipment, including all required components and accessories, simulation capabilities, software, training resources, warranty, technical support, maintenance, and any additional features or services included with the proposed system. .
onscreen_lines.note: See Exhibit I for full specifications. Please include training, delivery, software and warranty price when bidding on equipment.

onscreen_lines.desc: Pediatric Simulation Equipment The requested simulation equipment should provide opportunities for students to develop and practice essential pediatric patient-care skills, including patient assessment, vital sign monitoring, airway and respiratory management, medication administration, emergency response, and recognition of common pediatric conditions. The equipment should support faculty instruction, student practice, clinical decision-making, skills evaluation, and competency assessment. The proposed Pediatric Simulation Equipment should meet the specifications and requirements outlined in this RFP (Exhibit J) and be suitable for repeated use in an academic healthcare simulation environment. Vendors should provide complete information regarding the proposed equipment, including all required components and accessories, simulation capabilities, software, training resources, warranty, technical support, maintenance, and any additional features or services included with the proposed system.
onscreen_lines.note: See Exhibit J for full specifications. Please include training, delivery, software and warranty price when bidding on equipment.

onscreen_lines.desc: Automated Medication Dispensing System Hardware and Software The requested system should provide opportunities for students to develop and practice skills related to medication management, dispensing workflows, inventory control, medication security, user access, and safe medication administration. The system should support faculty instruction, student practice, simulation activities, and competency assessment within a controlled academic healthcare environment. The proposed Automated Medication Dispensing System should meet the specifications and requirements outlined in this RFP (Exhibit K) and be suitable for use in an academic healthcare education and simulation environment. Vendors should provide complete information regarding the proposed hardware and software, including system capabilities, user interfaces, medication storage and security features, reporting capabilities, required accessories, installation, training, software licensing, warranty, technical support, maintenance, and any additional features or services included with the proposed system.
onscreen_lines.note: See Exhibit K for full specifications. Please include training, delivery, software and warranty price when bidding on equipment.

onscreen_lines.desc: Cysto Dog Manikin The requested Cysto Dog Manikin should provide students with opportunities to develop proficiency in applicable clinical skills, including urinary catheterization, cystocentesis, and other related procedures as appropriate. The equipment should support faculty demonstrations, student practice, skills assessment, and competency development while reducing the need to perform initial practice procedures on live animals. The proposed Cysto Dog Manikin should meet the specifications and requirements outlined in this RFP (Exhibit L) and be suitable for repeated instructional use in an academic veterinary technology environment. Vendors should provide complete information regarding the proposed manikin, including all required components and accessories, training capabilities, replacement parts, warranty, technical support, maintenance requirements, and any additional features or services included with the proposed system.
onscreen_lines.note: See Exhibit L for full specifications. Please include training, delivery, software and warranty price when bidding on equipment.

onscreen_lines.desc: Chattanooga Continuum Neuromuscular Electrical Simulator The requested system should provide opportunities for students to develop and practice skills related to electrical stimulation, treatment parameter selection, electrode placement, patient safety, and appropriate therapeutic techniques. The equipment should support faculty instruction, student practice, demonstration, skills assessment, and competency development. The proposed Chattanooga Continuum Neuromuscular Electrical Simulator should meet the specifications and requirements outlined in this RFP (Exhibit M) and be suitable for repeated use in an academic healthcare education environment. Vendors should provide complete information regarding the proposed system, including all required components and accessories, software or controls, electrodes and related supplies, training resources, warranty, technical support, maintenance, and any additional features or services included with the proposed equipment.
onscreen_lines.note: See Exhibit M for full specifications. Please include training, delivery, software and warranty price when bidding on equipment.

onscreen_lines.desc: Sara Stedy Sit-To-Stand Aid The requested equipment should provide opportunities for students to develop and practice proper techniques for assisting patients with transfers while promoting patient safety, dignity, comfort, and mobility. The equipment should support faculty demonstrations, student practice, competency assessment, and preparation for clinical experiences involving patient handling and mobility. The proposed Sara Stedy Sit-to-Stand Aid should meet the specifications and requirements outlined in this RFP (Exhibit N) and be suitable for repeated instructional use in an academic healthcare environment. Vendors should provide complete information regarding the proposed equipment, including weight capacity, safety features, included components and accessories, training resources, warranty, maintenance, technical support, and any additional features or services included with the proposed system.
onscreen_lines.note: See Exhibit N for full specifications. Please include training, delivery, software and warranty price when bidding on equipment.

onscreen_lines.desc: Canine Urinary Catheter Models (Male and Female) The requested models should provide opportunities for students to develop proficiency in the proper placement, handling, and removal of urinary catheters in both male and female canine patients. The equipment should support faculty demonstration, student practice, skills assessment, and competency development while providing a safe and repeatable alternative for initial skills training. The proposed Canine Urinary Catheter Models should meet the specifications and requirements outlined in this RFP (Exhibit O) and be suitable for repeated instructional use. Vendors should provide complete information regarding the proposed models, including all required components and accessories, replacement parts, training resources, warranty, maintenance requirements, technical support, and any additional features or services included with the proposed equipment.
onscreen_lines.note: See Exhibit O for full specifications. Please include training, delivery, software and warranty price when bidding on equipment.

onscreen_lines.desc: AI-powered virtual concierge platform The proposed solution should support the delivery of accurate and timely information, assist with common inquiries and requests, and provide an enhanced user experience across applicable College services and resources. The system should be designed to integrate with existing College technology and workflows, as applicable, while maintaining appropriate security, privacy, accessibility, and administrative controls. Vendors should provide complete information regarding the proposed platform, including AI capabilities, functionality, integrations, implementation requirements, training, technical support, software licensing, maintenance, security features, data management, warranty or service terms, and any additional features or services included with the proposed solution.
